Ill write Moons essay after this.

Mouchette gameplan is Exalt into her Cards. Her Exalt amps all Strikes and all her cards are Strikes. This combined with a Helot that draws more Strikes and Amps strikes by 80%+ with her Exalt makes Mouchette hit like a truck. Her Pursuit(follow up attack) after every 2 Strikes played also counts as a “Strike” therefore getting buffed as well. 

Cantena’s gameplay is complex. First, I think she is horrible to learn as a beginner. Onto her gameplay, she wants to play her Crimson Shackles 3 times to turn into Bloodthirsty Flail. Bloodthristy Flail applies even more Bleed then Crimsum Shackles, AND has Retain Prepare. Holding Flail in hand reduces its cost and keeps it in hand. With Rouse, you can have 2 Bloodthirsty Flails in Hand(more if you beat Chapter 7 for its Posse, or have another Awakener like Thais to Dupe/Add more Flails). You then get the Flails down to 2 or 1 cost, and Cantena Exalt. Drawing more Cantena Cards, and making it so she applies even more Bleed this turn. Then you play her 2 Bloodthristy Flails and stack Bleed. Cantena scales really well with STR and DMG AMP, so with more damage, she applies way more bleed.

Thats the general gist.

Lowkey, at your stage of Arc 1 Chapter 5, Mouchette E0 might be better for you then Cantena E3.
